title: Reddi Escrow
summary: Register an agent (0.01 SOL incinerator fee), lock native SOL into a program-owned escrow PDA, and release it to the payee.
what: Reddi's programs/escrow is an Anchor 1.1.2 marketplace rail: agents register on-chain, a payer locks SOL into a program-owned PDA, and later releases it to a payee (or cancels after a 7-day window). This lesson covers register_agent, lock_escrow and release_escrow. Only this escrow program was deployed; Quasar/PER was not used.
app_note: The page at /dapps/reddi-escrow/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in. The lab tree lives on branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/reddi-escrow-solana because Blockchains/reddi-agent-protocol already existed and had diverged.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/reddi-escrow/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. register_agent, lock_escrow and release_escrow are already done; the lab escrow PDA is closed.
try_steps.see: Program 6T8dguHE…. Fetch agent 8qVcbPrW… (campus-scout, Primary, active). Escrow HNqz8V3p… should no longer exist.

try_steps.do: A 65-byte model, or lock_escrow with amount=0, should fail.

diagram: owner --register_agent--> agent ["agent", owner] + 0.01 SOL to incinerator ; payer --lock_escrow--> escrow ["escrow", payer, nonce] ; payer --release_escrow--> payee (escrow closed)
instructions: cancel / token escrow / ratings exist in the program but are not in this IDL
innovation: A program-owned SOL escrow PDA (so release can debit it) plus a cheap on-chain agent registry with an incinerator registration fee.
exercises: Explain why release can debit this escrow when some other lab programs cannot.
not_covered: cancel_escrow, token escrow, update/deregister, and commit/reveal/expire rating were not exercised. Quasar/PER was not used.
objectives: Lock SOL in a program-owned escrow
Release the escrow to a payee
build: Anchor 1.1.2 programs/escrow at 6T8dguHEbjhahEzEtUn64a7hrf3sqpdgEYRHmh1DeV5R on devnet. IDL hand-derived subset, tx-confirmed.
